title: Roast project config (.roast.json)
description: Every non-secret Roast setting. Credentials come only from environment variables; a profile names its variable with api_key_env.

$schema.description: Editor schema reference. Roast ignores it.

inference_profiles.description: Named model, endpoint, protocol, and credential variable combinations that roles select.

roles.description: Which inference profile each role uses.

verifier.description: Checks each proposed defect against the code.

confidence_floor.description: Minimum confidence to report a finding. Default 0.6.

quick_confidence_floor.description: Minimum confidence for a --quick review. Default 0.8.

excludes.description: Path patterns left out of every review.

snapshot.description: Record a Git snapshot of each review for replay. Default true.

prompts.description: Project files that replace the embedded prompt templates. A relative path is relative to the directory holding this config file. Setting any of these requires `npx roast trust` approval.

limits.description: Per-review limits. An unset limit uses the built-in default.

deadline.description: Wall-clock limit for one review. Default "10m"; "0s" disables.

request_timeout.description: Limit for one model request. Default "10m".

max_total_tokens.description: Token budget for one review. Default 3000000; 0 disables.

max_diff_bytes.description: Largest diff sent to the finder. Default 1000000.

max_prompt_bytes.description: Largest prompt sent in one request. Default 8000000.

max_file_ctx_bytes.description: Largest file context sent with the diff. Default 400000.

max_attempts.description: Attempts per model request, including the first. Default 4.

max_verified.description: Most findings sent to the verifier. Default 25.

interactive.description: Diff size below which an --interactive review uses a single finder call instead.

timeout_seconds.description: Gate watchdog in seconds. Default 180; 0 disables.

severity.description: Lowest severity that blocks a commit. Default HIGH.

offer.description: Whether the first interactive review offers to enable the gate. Default true.

endpoint.description: Base URL. Defaults to the protocol's public endpoint (https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://api.anthropic.com/v1). Any other endpoint requires `npx roast trust` approval and api_key_env.

model.description: Model ID sent to the endpoint.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the credential. A config never holds the credential itself.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token limit per request. Default 32768.

session_header.description: Extra request header that carries the per-conversation session ID, for gateways that need one.

pin.description: Finder only: keep this profile even when it shares the author's model family.

author_routes.description: Finder only: maps an author model or model family to another inference profile.

duration.description: A Go duration such as "90s" or "10m".
